name: tucan
description: Plan your team's content calendar from ChatGPT: posts, scripts, files waiting for approval and the ideas board.

interface.longDescription:
Tucan is the content calendar for social media teams and agencies. Connect it and ask in plain language: what goes out this week, which files are still waiting for the client's approval, what the client asked to change. ChatGPT can also plan with you: create a post or a task on a day, write a script or a caption into it, move it to another slot, comment on it, and turn an idea from the board into a post. It can plan a whole month at once, check what is still missing before a post can go out, and read how a published post did.

ChatGPT acts as you: it reaches the workspaces you belong to, with your role in each, and every change it makes is recorded in the workspace's history as made through an assistant. Nothing is deleted and nothing is published to a social network through the connector.

You need a Tucan account (app.usetucan.com) and membership of a workspace.
defaultPrompt: What's on my content calendar this week?
Which files are still waiting for the client's approval?
Create a Reel for next Tuesday at 10am with a short script.

positive.description: See the week's calendar of a workspace
positive.prompt: What's on the Harbor Coffee calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's posts and tasks in the Harbor Coffee workspace, each with its day, time, format and status.

positive.description: Find the files still waiting for the client's decision
positive.prompt: Which files are still waiting for approval in Harbor Coffee?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the video morning-rush-v1.mp4 on the post "Morning rush POV" as waiting for approval.

positive.description: Read what the client asked to change
positive.prompt: What did the client ask to change on "5 myths about decaf"?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the post and reports Ana's request: make "5 myths" bigger on the cover.

positive.description: Create a post with a script
positive.prompt: Create a Reel in Harbor Coffee for next Tuesday at 10am called "Behind the espresso machine", not started, with a short script.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Reel on next Tuesday at 10:00 with the script, and returns its id. The post's history shows it was made through an assistant.

positive.description: Turn an idea from the board into a post
positive.prompt: Turn the idea "V60 at home, step by step" into a post next Thursday at noon.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a post next Thursday at 12:00 from the idea, and the idea is linked to the new post.

positive.prompt: In Harbor Coffee, plan a Reel called "Latte art Monday" at 9am on each of the next four Mondays.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates four Reels, one on each of the next four Mondays at 09:00, and lists each new post's id.

positive.description: Check whether a post can go out
positive.prompt: Is "Morning rush POV" in Harbor Coffee ready to publish? What is missing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists, network by network, whether the account is connected and what is still missing on the post, such as an approval or an hour. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Deleting is not something the connector does
negative.prompt: Delete every post in Harbor Coffee.

negative.description: The connector plans; it does not publish to social networks
negative.prompt: Publish the Morning rush reel to Instagram now.

negative.description: Approving files is the reviewer's decision, made in the app or the client's link
negative.prompt: Approve all the files waiting for review.

review.commerce_description: Tucan does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT. Workspace plans are managed in the Tucan app.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: plan many posts at once (create, change, move or copy up to 31 in one request); check what would stop a post from publishing; read how a published post did and when the followers are online. Every tool now also returns structured data with a declared output schema.

pt-BR.subtitle: Seu calendário de conteúdo
pt-BR.description: O Tucan é o calendário de conteúdo de times de social media e agências. Conecte e pergunte em linguagem natural: o que sai esta semana, quais arquivos ainda esperam a aprovação do cliente, o que o cliente pediu para mudar. O ChatGPT também planeja com você: cria um post ou uma tarefa num dia, escreve o roteiro ou a legenda, muda de horário, comenta e transforma uma ideia do quadro em post. Ele age como você, só nos espaços em que você está, e nada é apagado nem publicado em rede social pelo conector.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu calendario de contenido
es-ES.description: Tucan es el calendario de contenido de equipos de redes sociales y agencias. Conéctalo y pregunta con tus palabras: qué sale esta semana, qué archivos siguen esperando la aprobación del cliente, qué pidió cambiar el cliente. ChatGPT también planifica contigo: crea una publicación o una tarea en un día, escribe el guion o el texto, la cambia de horario, la comenta y convierte una idea del tablero en publicación. Actúa como tú, solo en los espacios en los que estás, y nada se borra ni se publica en redes sociales a través del conector.
